name: Stuck by Design
source:
Graphic design was your passion. But now it's more like your prison as a timely snowstorm has left you and your coworker stranded in the office on Christmas Eve. It's not how you pictured you'd be spending the holidays, but it's better than spending it alone, right?

[From [url=https://craboozled.itch.io/stuck-by-design]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
平面设计是你的热情所在。但现在它更像是你的监狱，因为一场及时的暴风雪让你和你的同事在平安夜被困在办公室里。这不是你想象中的假期方式，但这比独自度过要好，对吧？

[来自[url=https://craboozled.itch.io/stuck-by-design]itch.io[/url]]
